# nemuro.in — 판독 구간 기록

구간은 1행부터 1128행까지 빈틈없이 이어진다.

| 1–40 | NEMURO Ecosystem Model Parameters / 입력 문법 — 제목·저작권·라이선스 주석을 포함한다(1–8). 키워드 순서, 주석·빈 줄, 이어쓰기(continuation), 마지막 값 반복, 곱셈 표기와 중첩 격자(nested grids)별 배열 순서를 설명한다(10–34). 단위와 기본값의 표기 규칙을 적는다(38–39). 원문: `! Input parameters can be entered in ANY order, provided that the parameter   !` (10); `! KEYWORD (usually, upper case) is typed correctly followed by "="  or "=="   !` (11); `! symbols. Any comment lines are allowed and must begin with an exclamation   !` (12); `! mark (!) in column one.  Comments may  appear to the right of a parameter   !` (13); `! specification to improve documentation.  Comments will be ignored  during   !` (14); `! reading.  Blank lines are also allowed and ignored. Continuation lines in   !` (15); `! a parameter specification are allowed and must be preceded by a backslash   !` (16); `! (\).  In some instances, more than one value is required for a parameter.   !` (17); `! If fewer values are provided, the  last value  is assigned for the entire   !` (18); `! parameter array.  The multiplication symbol (*),  without blank spaces in   !` (19); `! between, is allowed for a parameter specification.  For example, in a two   !` (20); `! grids nested application:                                                   !` (21); `!                                                                             !` (22); `!    AKT_BAK == 2*1.0d-6  2*5.0d-6              ! m2/s                        !` (23); `!                                                                             !` (24); `! indicates that the first two entries of array AKT_BAK,  in fortran column-  !` (25); `! major order, will have the same value of "1.0d-6" for grid 1,  whereas the  !` (26); `! next two entries will have the same value of "5.0d-6" for grid 2.           !` (27); `!                                                                             !` (28); `! In multiple levels of nesting and/or multiple connected domains  step-ups,  !` (29); `! "Ngrids" entries are expected for some of these parameters.  In such case,  !` (30); `! the order of the entries for a parameter is extremely important.  It  must  !` (31); `! follow the same order (1:Ngrids) as in the state variable declaration. The  !` (32); `! USER may follow the above guidelines for specifying his/her values.  These  !` (33); `! parameters are marked by "==" plural symbol after the KEYWORD.              !` (34); `!                                                                             !` (35); `!==============================================================================` (36); `! NOTICE: Input parameter units are specified within brackets and default` (38); `! ******  values are specified within braces.` (39). |

| 752–787 | Physical Parameters / sponge·수직 혼합·뉴징 — 완충 영역 스위치와 CPP SPONGE 대체, 혼합 분포 갱신식 두 개, diff_factor 입력 또는 ANA_SPONGE 해석 함수의 조건을 적는다(752–772). 배경 수직 혼합, FORWARD_MIXING일 때 사용하는 수반 규모 계수와 뉴징 역수 계산을 적는다(774–786). 원문: `!  LtracerSponge  Logical switches (TRUE/FALSE) to increase/decrease horizontal` (752); `!                   diffusivity of biological tracers in specific areas of the` (753); `!                   domain. It can be used to specify sponge areas with larger` (754); `!                   horizontal mixing coefficients for damping of high` (755); `!                   frequency noise due to open boundary conditions or nesting.` (756); `!                   The CPP option SPONGE is now deprecated and replaced with` (757); `!                   this switch to facilitate or not sponge areas over a` (758); `!                   particular nested grid; [1:NBT,1:Ngrids] values are` (759); `!                   expected.` (760); `!                   The horizontal mixing distribution is specified in` (762); `!                   "ini_hmixcoef.F" as:` (763); `!                     diff2(i,j,itrc) = diff_factor(i,j) * diff2(i,j,itrc)` (765); `!                     diff4(i,j,itrc) = diff_factor(i,j) * diff4(i,j,itrc)` (766); `!                   The variable "diff_factor" can be read from the grid` (768); `!                   NetCDF file. Alternately, the horizontal diffusion in the` (769); `!                   sponge area can be set-up with analytical functions in` (770); `!                   "ana_sponge.h" using CPP ANA_SPONGE when these switches` (771); `!                   are turned ON for a particular grid.` (772); `!  AKT_BAK        Background vertical mixing coefficient (m2/s) for biological` (774); `!                   tracer variables, [1:NBT,1:Ngrids] values are expected.` (775); `!  ad_AKT_fac     Adjoint-based algorithms vertical mixing, basic state,` (778); `!                   scale factor (nondimensional) for biological tracer` (779); `!                   variables; [1:NBT,1:Ngrids] values are expected. In` (780); `!                   some applications, a smaller/larger values of vertical` (781); `!                   mixing are necessary for stability. It is only used` (782); `!                   when FORWARD_MIXING is activated.` (783); `!  TNUDG          Nudging time scale (days), [1:NBT,1:Ngrids]. | 788–836 | Tracer advection scheme / 알고리즘·조건 — 추적자별 스위치, 양의 장·온도에 대한 알고리즘 선택 설명과 알고리즘 목록·축약 규칙을 적는다(792–815). HSIMT 또는 MPDATA에서 단조성(monotonicity)을 보존하려면 수평·수직에 같은 기법을 설정해야 한다는 조건과 각 키워드의 차원을 적는다(817–835). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (788); `! Tracer advection scheme.` (789); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (790); `! It is more advantageous to set the horizontal and vertical advection schemes` (792); `! for each tracer with switches instead of a single CPP flag for all of them.` (793); `! Positive-definite and monotonic algorithms (i.e., MPDATA and HSIMT) are` (794); `! appropriate and useful for positive fields like salinity, inert, biological,` (795); `! and sediment tracers.  However, since the temperature has a dynamic range` (796); `! with negative and positive values in the ocean, other advection schemes are` (797); `! more appropriate.` (798); `! Currently, the following tracer advection schemes are available and are` (800); `! activated using the associated Keyword:` (801); `!   Keyword    Advection Algorithm` (803); `!   A4         4th-order Akima (horizontal/vertical)` (805); `!   C2         2nd-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (806); `!   C4         4th-order centered differences (horizontal/vertical)` (807); `!   HSIMT      3th-order HSIMT with TVD limiter (horizontal/vertical)` (808); `!   MPDATA     recursive flux corrected MPDATA (horizontal/vertical)` (809); `!   SPLINES    parabolic splines reconstruction (only vertical)` (810); `!   SU3        split third-order upstream (horizontal/vertical)` (811); `!   U3         3rd-order upstresm-bias (only horizontal)` (812); `! The user has the option of specifying the full Keyword or the first` (814); `! two letters, regardless if using uppercase or lowercase.` (815); `! If using either HSIMT (Wu and Zhu, 2010) or MPDATA (Margolin and` (817); `! Smolarkiewicz, 1998) options, the user needs to set the same scheme` (818); `! for both horizontal and vertical advection to preserve monotonicity.` (819); `! Hadvection     Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (821); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (822); `!                  values are expected.` (823); `! Vadvection     Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (825); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids]` (826); `!                  values are expected.` (827); `! ad_Hadvection  Horizontal advection for each active (temperature and` (829); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (830); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (831); `! ad_Vadvection  Vertical advection for each active (temperature and` (833); `!                  salinity) and inert tracers in the adjoint-based` (834); `!                  algorithms, [1:NAT+NPT,Ngrids] values are expected.` (835). |
| 837–874 | Tracer advection scheme / 입력 예시 — 온도·염분·비활성 추적자(inert tracers)의 이어쓰기 예시와 격자별 이류 예시를 적는다(837–863). 모든 수동 추적자(passive tracers)의 수평·수직 기법이 같을 때 쓰는 축약 입력 예시를 적는다(865–873). 원문: `! Examples:` (837); `!  Hadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (839); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (840); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (841); `!                HSIMT                          ! dy2_02, inert(2)` (842); `!  Vadvection == A4       \                     ! temperature` (844); `!                MPDATA   \                     ! salinity` (845); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! dye_01, inert(1)` (846); `!                HSIMT                          ! dye_02, inert(2)` (847); `! or in nested applications` (849); `!  Hadvection == U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (851); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (852); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (853); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (854); `!                U3       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (855); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (856); `!  Vadvection == C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 1` (858); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 1` (859); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 2` (860); `!                HSIMT    \                     ! salinity,    Grid 2` (861); `!                C4       \                     ! temperature, Grid 3` (862); `!                HSIMT                          ! salinity,    Grid 3` (863); `! It is convinient to use the compact specification format for biological and` (865); `! sediment passive tracers as:` (866); `!  Hadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (868); `!  Vadvection == HSIMT                          ! idbio(:), compact` (870); `! when all the passive tracers have the same horizontal and vertical tracer` (872); `! advection scheme.` (873). |
| 875–899 | Lateral boundary conditions parameters / 구조·키워드 — 논리 스위치와 LBC 구조 배열의 차원을 적는다(879–886). 각 방향의 gradient 구성 예시, 대소문자 규칙과 RadNud 복합 조건을 적는다(887–898). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (875); `! Lateral boundary conditions parameters.` (876); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (877); `! The lateral boundary conditions are now specified with logical switches` (879); `! instead of CPP flags to allow nested grid configurations. Their values are` (880); `! load into structured array:` (881); `!    LBC(1:4, nLBCvar, Ngrids)` (883); `! where 1:4 are the number of boundary edges, nLBCvar are the number LBC state` (885); `! variables, and Ngrids is the number of nested grids. For Example, to apply` (886); `! gradient boundary conditions to any tracer we use:` (887); `!    LBC(iwest,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (889); `!    LBC(ieast,  isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (890); `!    LBC(isouth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (891); `!    LBC(inorth, isTvar(itrc), ng) % gradient` (892); `! The lateral boundary conditions for biological tracers are entered with` (894); `! a keyword. This keyword is case insensitive and usually has three characters.` (895); `! However, it is possible to have compound keywords, if applicable. For example,` (896); `! the keyword "RadNud" implies radiation boundary condition with nudging. This` (897); `! combination is usually used in active/passive radiation conditions.` (898). |
| 900–935 | Lateral boundary conditions / 축약 예시·도식 — 동서 주기(periodic) 적용에서 생물 추적자 전체에 한 경계 조건 항목을 쓰는 예시를 적는다(900–916). 경계 유형 문자 도식은 북·남·서·동을 4·2·1·3으로 배치한다(918–927). 비선형·수반 기반 키워드의 차원을 적는다(929–934). 원문: `! It is possible to specify the lateral boundary conditions for all biological` (900); `! tracers in a compact form with a single entry.  for example, in a East-West` (901); `! periodic application we can just have:` (902); `!                   W       S       E       N` (904); `!                   e       o       a       o` (905); `!                   s       u       s       r` (906); `!                   t       t       t       t` (907); `!                           h               h` (908); `!                   1       2       3       4` (910); `!  LBC(isTvar) ==   Per     Clo     Per     Clo` (912); `! Then, the standard input processing routine will assume that all the` (914); `! biological tracers have the same lateral boundary condition specified by` (915); `! the single entry.` (916); `!   Keyword    Lateral Boundary Condition Type` (918); `!   Cla        Clamped                                _____N_____     j=Mm` (920); `!   Clo        Closed                                \|     4     \|` (921); `!   Gra        Gradient                              \|           \|` (922); `!   Nes        Nested                              1 W           E 3` (923); `!   Nud        Nudging                               \|           \|` (924); `!   Per        Periodic                              \|_____S_____\|` (925); `!   Rad        Radiation                                   2          j=1` (926); `!                                                   i=1         i=Lm` (927); `!  LBC(isTvar)    Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (929); `! Similarly, the adjoint-based algorithms (ADM, TLM, RPM) can have different` (931); `! lateral boundary conditions keywords:` (932); `!  ad_LBC(isTvar) Biological Tracers, [1:4, 1:NBT, Ngrids] values are expected.` (934). |
| 936–987 | Tracer point Sources/Sink sources switches — LtracerSrc의 차원과 생물 추적자별 인덱스·설명을 적는다(937–953). 모든 하천의 온도·염분 지정 의무와 다른 추적자의 선택성, river_flag를 대체하는 스위치·이전 NetCDF 속성 예시·이전 형식 호환(backward compatibility)을 적는다(955–976). 공급이 없는 하천도 해당 추적자의 0 값을 지정해야 한다는 조건을 적는다(978–986). 원문: `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (936); `!  Tracer point Sources/Sink sources switches: [1:NBT,1:Ngrids].` (937); `!------------------------------------------------------------------------------` (938); `!  LtracerSrc     Logical switches (T/F) to activate biological tracer` (940); `!                   variables point Sources/Sinks.` (941); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 1),ng)    Small Phytoplankton biomass` (943); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 2),ng)    Large Phytoplankton biomass` (944); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 3),ng)    Small Zooplankton biomass` (945); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 4),ng)    Large Zooplankton biomass` (946); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 5),ng)    Predator Zooplankton biomass` (947); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 6),ng)    Nitrate concentration` (948); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 7),ng)    Ammonium concentration` (949); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 8),ng)    Particulate Organic Nitrogen` (950); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio( 9),ng)    Dissolved Organic Nitrogen` (951); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio(10),ng)    Silicate concentration` (952); `!                     LtracerSrc(idbio(11),ng)    Particulate organic silica` (953); `!                   Recall that these switches are usually activated to add` (955); `!                   river runoff as a point source. At minimum, it is necessary` (956); `!                   to specify both temperature and salinity for all rivers.` (957); `!                   The other tracers are optional. The user needs to know the` (958); `!                   correspondence between biological variables and indices` (959); `!                   idbio(1:NBT) when activating one or more of these switches.` (960); `!                   These logical switches REPLACES and ELIMINATES the need to` (962); `!                   have or read the variable "river_flag(river)" in the input` (963); `!                   rivers forcing NetCDF file:` (964); `!                     double river_flag(river)` (966); `!                        river_flag:long_name = "river runoff tracer flag"` (967); `!                        river_flag:option_0 = "all tracers are off"` (968); `!                        river_flag:option_1 = "only temperature"` (969); `!                        river_flag:option_2 = "only salinity"` (970); `!                        river_flag:option_3 = "both temperature and salinity"` (971); `!                        river_flag:units = "nondimensional"` (972); `!                   This logic was too cumbersome and complicated when` (974); `!                   additional tracers are considered. However, this change` (975); `!                   is backward compatible.` (976); `!                   The LtracerSrc switch will be used to activate the reading` (978); `!                   of respective tracer variable from input river forcing` (979); `!                   NetCDF file. If you want to add other tracer variables` (980); `!                   (other than temperature and salinity) as a source for a` (981); `!                   particular river(s), you just need to specify such values` (982); `!                   on those river(s). Then, set the values to ZERO on the` (983); `!                   other river(s) that do NOT require such river forcing for` (984); `!                   that tracer. Recall that you need to specify the tracer` (985); `!                   values for all rivers, even if their values are zero.` (986). |

## 판독 중 확인된 사실 (판단 아님, 후속 검토 대상)

- 409: AVERAGE 출력의 기대값 차원 문자열은 `[1;NBT,Ngrids]`이다. 같은 파일의 HISTORY·QUICKSAVE·DIAGNOSTIC 차원은 `[1:NBT,Ngrids]` 형식이다(394·401·421).
- 137·578–579: `GRmaxLzs`의 설정 주석은 `large Zoo on small Zoo`, 용어집 설명은 `Small Zooplankton ... on Small Zooplankton`이다.
- 140·587–588: `GRmaxPzl`의 설정 주석은 `predator Zoo on large Zoo`, 용어집 설명은 `Predator Zooplankton ... on Large Phytoplankton`이다.
- 161·614–615: `KZS2ZL`의 설정 주석은 `large Zoo on small Zoo`, 용어집 설명은 `Large Zooplankton ... ingestion on Small Phytoplankton`이다.
- 174·644–645: `ZL2ZPstar`의 설정 주석은 `predator Zoo on large Zoo`, 용어집 설명은 `Small Zooplankton ... grazing on Small Phytoplankton`이다.
- 239–243·752–760: `LtracerSponge`의 기대값 차원은 설정 앞 주석에서 `[Ngrids]`, 용어집에서 `[1:NBT,1:Ngrids]`이다. 설정은 `LtracerSponge == 11*F`이다.
- 391·1018·1024–1034: 뉴징 스위치 이름은 설정·용어집·앞 열 개 예시에서 `LnudgeTCLM`이다. 마지막 opal 예시만 `LnuegeTCLM(idbio(11),ng)`를 쓴다(1034).
